source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Spiny shrub to ca. 2 m, branches ending in thorns
morphology_documented.leaves: Obovate (10–)15–20 mm long, apex usually rounded, base acuminate, entire or rarely few teeth
morphology_documented.fruit: Globose fleshy dark-blue/black drupe 5–6 mm diameter

source_scope_note: Genus/key traits explicitly identified; modern secondary evidence separately cited; no unsupported species characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: The flora explicitly compares C. hookeri with Ziziphus obtusifolia (current Condaliopsis), so preserve the contrast
Condalia has non-glaucous branches and brighter obovate leaves vs the glaucous twig/variable leaf of lotebush
preservation: Additive file; existing species records, photographs, credits and galleries unchanged
